newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RUGBY UNION-THREE NEW SPRINGBOKS TO PLAY IN MENDOZA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-THREE NEW SPRINGBOKS TO PLAY IN MENDOZA.

text.p: South Africa will field three new players in the second game of their tour of Argentina on Tuesday, against Cuyo.
Wayne Fyvie will lead a side which includes debutants Natal centre Jeremy Thompson, Western Province wing Breyton Paulse and Griqualand West flanker Theo Oosthuizen.
Paulse is the only black player in the tour squad and his selection completes a meteoric rise for the 20-year- old from Stellenbosch.
Paulse scored a hat trick of tries on his debut for Western Province in July but did not command a regular place for the province when he was chosen to go on the Springbok tour.
The Cuyo team was being announced late on Monday and the Springboks will be up against a couple of familiar faces in the front row where test men Roberto Grau and Federico Mendez will prop the scrum.

Mendez became the first player from Mendoza to represent the Pumas when he was selected six years ago at the age of 18. On Tuesday he moves from hooker to tighthead, the position in which he started his career.
The Springboks spent Monday relaxing on a coach tour into the Andes mountains, before training under lights at the Independiente Rivadavia stadium in the evening.

South African team - 15 Russell Bennett, 14 Andre Snyman, 13 Jeremy Thompson, 12 Dick Muir, 11 Breyton Paulse, 10 Franco Smith, 9 Kevin Putt, 8 Schutte Bekker, 7 Wayne Fyvie, 6 Theo Oosthuizen, 5 Krynauw Otto, 4 Fritz van Heerden, 3 Marius Hurter, 2 Chris Rossouw, 1 Garry Pagel.
